item.title: Speaker - Gatherverse XREvolve Summit 2026 | AI and XR
item.description: XREvolve Summit - XR and AI: Extending Humanity, is where extended reality and artificial intelligence converge once more to extend the future of human and machine collaboration. As AI becomes more generative, adaptive, and intuitive, and XR scales into everyday environments, this summit explores how these technologies together transform industries, human connection and immersive realities. Virtual reality, augmented reality and mixed reality continue to blur the lines of work, leisure, and creativity, accelerating breakthroughs in training social interaction and collaboration The metaverse remains at the center of these converging technologies now more intelligent, ethical, and accessible than ever.

item.title: Mail Merge in Java
item.description: MailMerge is a process to create personalized letters and pre-addressed envelopes or mailing labels for mass mailings from a word processing document (Template). A template contains placeholders (Fields) along with the actual content. The placeholders are filled by the data source which is typically a spreadsheet or a database having column for each place holders. This article talks about the java approach for generating multiple documents from a single MS Word template.
